purpose: Teach: それ程/くるくる/エライ/終われ/あたたかい/はっと/通り越し/飛び出す

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも、それ程怒ったりしないわよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm not angry with you at all, you know.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance with a soft smile beneath the words. Warm, open tone. Slightly slower pace to let the reassurance land. The confidence of someone who has nothing to prove.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、独楽がくるくる回るの好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like watching the top spin around and around.
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm. Open vowels on 'like.' Small-boy directness — not performing, just sharing something he loves. Slight lean-forward energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんもお手伝いがエライ得意なのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm actually really good at helping, you know.
lines.style: Quiet pride without boasting. Gentle offer underneath — 'I can help you.' Steady, reliable tone. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描き終われなくて困ってるんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got stuck. I couldn't finish my drawing.
lines.style: Small, worried admission. Hesitant opening, like he's checking if it's okay to ask for help. Soft and a little uncertain, but trusting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはあたたかい色のお洋服が好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I really like clothes in warm colours, you know.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost to herself. Tender, conversational. A moment of softness where she's letting him see something about her. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お花を見てはっと立ち止まったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the flowers and just stopped and stared.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. Slight breathiness on 'stopped' — the pause captured in the voice. Present-tense immediacy. The simple awe of a child noticing something beautiful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと公園を通り越してお祖父ちゃんの家まで歩こう
lines.en: Sho, let's walk past the park together and go all the way to Grandpa's house.
lines.style: Gentle invitation with quiet certainty. Warm, unhurried pace. The voice of someone who knows exactly where they're going and wants him there too. Tender without being precious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、家を飛び出すようにメイ姉さんに会いに来たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran straight out of the house to come see you.
lines.style: Eager, breathless admission. The rush of his own urgency still in his voice. Open and unguarded — the kind of thing a child says without calculating whether it's too much. Quick, direct.
